prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a rear-end collision. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1304; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with a diagnosis of concussion. Symptoms reported at initial evaluation included headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating, and the reported injury is consistent with the mechanism of a crash of this kind. Across four visits, the patient was managed with symptom monitoring, cognitive and activity guidance, and a graded return to routine tasks. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the injury. No prior injury to the head or neck region is known from the patient's history. Treatment followed a usual course for this condition, with visit frequency and symptom burden both tapering as the patient improved. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each encounter. At the most recent visit, the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms and was advised to continue gradual activity and to return if symptoms recur.
